title: Valid Anagram
statement: Return true when `t` is an anagram of `s`. Both strings are lowercase English letters.
hints: Equal length is required. A longer string cannot be an anagram.
Sorting both strings and comparing them is correct.
A single frequency array of 26 counters is linear and uses constant extra memory.

approaches.name: Frequency count
approaches.explanation: Increment for s and decrement for t. Every counter must end at zero.

editorial: An anagram preserves character multiplicity and nothing else. Counting letters in s and subtracting letters in t detects both missing and extra characters. If the lengths differ you can return immediately.
